name: accessible-icon
title: Accessible Icon
description: Gives an icon that stands alone a name for screen readers, and hides the drawing itself from them.

meta.when: An icon that carries meaning with no words beside it and is not itself a control: a status mark in a table cell, a warning beside a figure. An icon-only button or link takes `aria-label` on the control instead; an icon beside its own words is decoration and takes `aria-hidden`; for other words that only a screen reader needs use visually-hidden.
